title: Captain Prabhakar
desc: Prabhakaran, a forest officer, is assigned to arrest the notorious smuggler Veerabhadran. While duty calls, Prabhakaran also decides to avenge his friend's death.

title: Vandhaan Vendraan
desc: On the request of the woman he loves, Arjun goes to great lengths to put his half-brother Ramana, who is a don, behind bars. However, his attempts put him in a dangerous situation.

title: Veera Sivaji
desc: Sivaji, a taxi driver, strives to raise money for the surgery of his niece. However, chaos ensues when he gets deceived and strives to overcome the challenges.

title: Vallinam
desc: Due to a fatal accident, Krishna, a basketball player, moves to a new college. There he locks horns with Vamsi, a cricket maniac, who does not let other sports gain importance.

title: Irudhi Suttru
desc: A failed boxer sees potential in a roadside fish-seller and begins to train her to compete in the women's boxing category in the Olympics.
